title: Organisation and dynamics of individual DNA segments in topologically complex genomes.
authors: Ramakrishnan, Saminathan; Grillo, Guglielmo; Patnaik, Auro Varat; Tubiana, Luca; Michieletto, Davide
one_liner_zh: 该文利用dCas9-QD标记和模拟研究动质体DNA网络的组织与动态，虽涉及DNA结合蛋白和模拟方法，但核心是基因组拓扑结构而非TF-DNA特异性互作，方法可迁移但匹配度中等。
abstract: Capturing the physical organisation and dynamics of genomic regions is one of the major open challenges in biology. The kinetoplast DNA (kDNA) is a topologically complex genome, made by thousands of DNA (mini and maxi) circles interlinked into a two-dimensional Olympic network. The organisation and dynamics of these DNA circles are poorly understood. In this paper, we show that dCas9 linked to quantum dots (QD) can efficiently label DNA maxicircles and different classes of DNA minicircles in kDNA. We use this method to study the distribution and dynamics of different classes of DNA minicircles within the network. We discover that maxicircles display a preference to localise at the periphery of the network and that they undergo subdiffusive dynamics. By using simulations, we discover that this peripheral localisation of maxicircles may contribute to the bucking of the structure in solution. Finally, by tracking the dynamics of the QDs we can also quantify the effective network stiffness, confirming previous indirect estimations via AFM. Our method could be used more generally to quantify the location, dynamics, and material properties of genomic regions in other complex genomes, such as that of bacteria, and to study their behaviour in the presence of DNA-binding proteins.
abstract_zh: 捕捉基因组区域的物理组织与动态是生物学中一项重大未解挑战。动基体DNA（kDNA）是一个拓扑复杂的基因组，由数千个DNA（小环和大环）圆环相互连接成二维奥林匹克网络。这些DNA圆环的组织与动态目前了解甚少。在本文中，我们展示了与量子点（QD）连接的dCas9能够高效标记kDNA中的DNA大环和不同类别的DNA小环。我们利用此方法研究网络中不同类别DNA小环的分布与动态。我们发现大环倾向于定位在网络外围，并表现出亚扩散动态。通过模拟，我们发现大环的这种外围定位可能有助于结构在溶液中的弯曲。最后，通过追踪量子点的动态，我们还能量化有效网络刚度，证实了先前通过原子力显微镜（AFM）的间接估计。我们的方法可更广泛地用于量化其他复杂基因组（如细菌基因组）中基因组区域的位置、动态和材料特性，并研究其在DNA结合蛋白存在下的行为。
